notes: Created comprehensive BDD implementation plan for mobile touch enhancements covering 5 issues across 4 phases. Phase 1 (P0): PointerEvents migration from TouchEvents + touch-action fix. Phase 2 (P1): Zoom sensitivity increase (0.15 → 0.3) + swap prevention. Phase 3 (P2): Bottom sheet title controls parity (7 missing controls). Phase 4 (P3): Touch resize handle discoverability. Plan includes ~31 new test scenarios across user behavior, component behavior, and pure function levels. Consulted @world-review for UX priorities and @planner for technical approach. Key architectural insight: removing TouchEvent path and enabling PointerEvent for touch pointers with setPointerCapture resolves both pan-dropping and swap-during-pinch issues simultaneously.
